title: add RAG agent examples and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Add RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling examples, and a set of quickstarts targeted at developer onboarding. Motivation: consolidate recent community patterns and provide runnable examples that demonstrate tool-calling + RAG flows with Redwood SDKs (Python/TS) and the docs site. This PR includes: - new example repository folders under redwood-examples/rag-agents showing minimal and production-ready patterns - docs site updates with Quickstarts, API snippets, and a new 'Agents and Tool Calling' guide - a small test harness + docker-compose example for local testing - updated README and changelog entries Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates for FAQ, customer-support, and code-assistant agents - [x] Add tool-calling examples for HTTP lookup and external search connector - [x] Provide Python and TypeScript quickstarts with step-by-step instructions - [x] Docs site page and nav entry added, includes runnable snippets - [x] CI docs build passes after fix for mdx import path Context: This work consolidates several earlier quick PRs and community contributions (see related PRs pr-54123, pr-54284, pr-53888). It is intended to be low-risk for runtime but high-value for developer experience. Notes: The description contains consolidated blocks for clarity; code samples are small and intentionally curated to avoid large diffs. See changed_files for the list of touched modules and the review_comments section for design discussion and follow-ups.
